name: AWS GuardDuty: pull findings
description: Every 5 minutes, lists non-archived GuardDuty findings updated since the previous run in one region (ListFindings + GetFindings, SigV4) and creates one pending alert per finding (source aws-guardduty, deduplicated on the finding id, severity from the 1-10 score).

params.label: AWS region
params.help: Region code, lower case (us-east-1, eu-west-1, ...). One region per installed workflow.

params.label: Detector id
params.help: GuardDuty detector id in that region (GuardDuty console > Settings, or `aws guardduty list-detectors`).

secrets.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
secrets.description: Access key id of a dedicated IAM user (read-only policy below).

secrets.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
secrets.description: Secret access key of the same IAM user.

setup:
## AWS side
1. Create an IAM user for this integration (no console access) with an inline policy allowing only `guardduty:ListFindings` and `guardduty:GetFindings` on `arn:aws:guardduty:<region>:<account>:detector/<detector-id>` (or attach the managed policy `AmazonGuardDutyReadOnlyAccess`).
2. Create an access key for it and store the two values as the secrets `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, allowed host `guardduty.<region>.amazonaws.com`.
3. Find the detector id (GuardDuty > Settings > Detector ID). In a delegated-administrator account the detector also returns member accounts' findings.

## How it works
- `list`: `POST https://guardduty.<region>.amazonaws.com/detector/<id>/findings` (ListFindings) with criterion `updatedAt` `greaterThanOrEqual` = previous run time in epoch milliseconds and `service.archived` `equals` `["false"]`, sorted by `updatedAt` DESC, `maxResults` 50 (the API maximum).
- `details`: when ids came back, `POST .../findings/get` (GetFindings) with those `findingIds` (max 50).
- One alert per finding: external id = finding `id`, title = `title (account/region)`, severity: 9.0-10 critical, 7.0-8.9 high, 4.0-6.9 medium, 1.0-3.9 low.
- **Updates do not re-alert.** GuardDuty updates a finding in place when the activity repeats (`service.count`, `updatedAt`); `createdAt` cannot be filtered on, so the pull filters on `updatedAt` and the external id is the finding id only. A repeated finding is re-read but returns the existing alert (no new alert, no second `alert.ingested`). To get a new alert per update, change the external id to `{{ loop.item.id }}:{{ loop.item.updatedAt }}`.
- A non-200 answer fails the run with `GuardDuty ListFindings/GetFindings failed: HTTP <status>`; the next run re-reads the window.

## Limits
- ponytail: one page per run: at most **50 findings per 5-minute window** (newest first); `nextToken` is not followed.
- One region per workflow: install the template again per region.
- Static access keys only (no assume-role). To use temporary credentials add `session_token` to both `auth` blocks.

Docs: [ListFindings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/APIReference/API_ListFindings.html), [GetFindings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/APIReference/API_GetFindings.html), [Condition](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/APIReference/API_Condition.html), [Severity levels](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/guardduty_findings-severity.html), [IAM actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/service-authorization/latest/reference/list_amazonguardduty.html).

config.body: {%- macro ep(s) -%}{%- set mo = s[5:7]|int -%}{%- set y = (s[0:4]|int) - (1 if mo <= 2 else 0) -%}{%- set era = y // 400 -%}{%- set yoe = y - era * 400 -%}{%- set doe = yoe * 365 + yoe // 4 - yoe // 100 + (153 * (mo + (-3 if mo > 2 else 9)) + 2) // 5 + (s[8:10]|int) - 1 -%}{{ ((era * 146097 + doe - 719468) * 86400 + (s[11:13]|int) * 3600 + (s[14:16]|int) * 60 + (s[17:19]|int)) }}{%- endmacro -%}{"findingCriteria": {"criterion": {"updatedAt": {"greaterThanOrEqual": {{ ep(trigger.since)|int * 1000 }}}, "service.archived": {"equals": ["false"]}}}, "sortCriteria": {"attributeName": "updatedAt", "orderBy": "DESC"}, "maxResults": 50}

config.title: {{ loop.item.get('title') or loop.item.get('type') or 'GuardDuty finding' }} ({{ loop.item.get('accountId') or '?' }}/{{ loop.item.get('region') or '?' }})
config.severity: {% set s = loop.item.get('severity') or 0 %}{{ 'critical' if s >= 9 else 'high' if s >= 7 else 'medium' if s >= 4 else 'low' if s >= 1 else 'info' }}
